post.summary: Start a saved Reddit lookup with browsing included
post.description: Costs 1 core_search unit. Collects only the profile, always saves it (even if save:false), and returns data.profile and meta.savedResult.id. No polling. Subsequent /browse calls with that ID are free. Default page size is 25. Reuse the saved ID rather than calling lookup again on refresh.

403.description: API authentication or tools plan feature required

503.description: Result could not be saved or quota could not be checked

post.summary: Browse an owned saved Reddit result without additional search charges
post.description: Free for saved lookup/all results. Verifies creator and API-key ownership before reading cache or calling providers. Account is derived from the saved result. Does not mutate the saved snapshot. Defaults inherit the saved query; options starts a new view. Reuse nextCursor without options for pagination. A cursor is not authorization. Archived coverage and throughput depend on providers.

200.description: Section data; posts/comments include pagination.nextCursor (null at end).

403.description: API authentication or tools plan feature required

404.description: Saved result unavailable, deleted, belongs to another owner/key, or is not Reddit

409.description: RESULT_BROWSING_NOT_INCLUDED: use a saved lookup/all result, or complete a saved profile through feed

post.summary: Collect feed or complete a saved profile
post.description: Costs 2 core_search units. With resultId, verifies ownership and matching username, then upgrades the saved profile to all under the same ID. Without resultId, returns feed-only data without persistence. Prefer browse for an already completed result.
Costs 3 core_search units. Returns the first page only, with up to 100 posts and 100 comments. With save:true, the saved ID includes free /browse pagination and enrichment.
